notes: upstreamNotes: Charges up next fireball-based move (Hadoken, Hashogeki, SA1, SA2) into a more powerful Denjin version; Ryu is in a counter-hit state for the entire animation; gains the Denjin charge on frame 50; can only store 1 stock at a time (does not persist between rounds); can also be performed after 5HP~HK or 5MP~LK~HK (on hit) by inputting 2P
ユーザー指定: 強度未指定の採用済み基本必殺技の共通値をL/M/Hのゲーム用代表値へ展開。実性能一致を保証せず、ODは生成しない。
